name: Nem nướng
summary: Grilled pork with bánh tráng phơi sương, fresh herbs, and a sauce mixed in the shop. At bà Hùng the pork is lean.
origin: Da Lat nem nướng, a different plate from the one other cities serve. At bà Hùng the pork is lean.
howToEat: The rolls come with bánh tráng phơi sương and fresh herbs, and the sauce is mixed in the shop.
Bà Nghĩa also sells bánh xèo and chả giò, as separate plates.
where: Nem nướng bà Hùng, 5 Trần Phú. Nem nướng bà Nghĩa, 45 Bùi Thị Xuân.
priceBand: Visit Lâm Đồng prints 45,000 VND a portion at bà Hùng and 45,000–70,000 VND at bà Nghĩa.
seoDescription: Grilled pork with bánh tráng phơi sương, fresh herbs, and a sauce mixed in the shop. At bà Hùng the pork is lean.
